en: If I don't consciously hold this posture, I melt back down to a mound. Am I getting old?
I just saw a modern masterpiece in the theatre.
It's a shame that I don't have a friend I can share the experience with.
Huh? This is strange. The batting center is supposed to be around here, isn't it?
Ooh, look at that. That girl looks so pure and innocent, but...
Huh? What do you want? Don't bug me, I'm watching couples going into the love hotel. Checking out the girls turns me on.
I wish I could quit work, go off somewhere, and cut loose. I really need a break from the grind.
Tomorrow's just another day to endure...
The days are so short in the winter. It makes me kind of blue.
Didja see "Love to See You Smile" last night? It was so good!
Yeah, yeah, yeah! I saw it, too! That new pop star's a cutie!
Today's a good day! I can't lose, even if I try! Hahaha!
I'm starving, but that actually makes it harder to decide what to eat. There's so many great places around here, and they all smell fantastic!
Please drop in and check out our classic games and PrintCircle booths!
Who has the best takoyaki? Personally, I think Magutako's hard to top.
Belt out your favorite tunes and blow the blues away! Welcome to Karaokekan!
Every time it snows, it reminds me of him... Pardon me! Were you listening?
I'm not pulling your leg, there really was this total minx at a hostess club I went to. Her name was, uh... Kaguya-chan, I think.
Where? Rose Hip's the place. It's on Lavender Street, you know, southwest from Chuo Station Boulevard.
I'm getting tired of pretending to be the perfect little boy for all those grown-ups... Like saying I still believe in Santa Claus.
I didn't know the Self-Defense Force prepared all the giant ice blocks for the Snow Festival.
Please check us out! Classic games and PrintCircle machines are front and center!
Beef rice so good! I swear, I could eat that for every meal for the rest of my life.
Mahjong's the game if you're into tactics and outguessing your opponents. Try Orchid Palace just east of here. It's in an alley off Nakamichi Street.
Hey, big guy. Interested in a good time? You can unload yourself of all sorts of things, if you catch my drift.
Hi, want to party with me? I can show you a real good time.
My favorite game's getting a sequel soon. I can hardly wait!
You're born and raised locally, but you can't take the cold at all, huh? Figured that Hokkaido blood would help out with that.
No way! People in Hokkaido hate the cold! That's why we've got so many underground malls and double doors here.
I don't want to work anymore! Why can't I meet some business tycoon or an oil magnate?
I took a nap on a park bench on my lunch break, and, uh... I just woke up. Sun's settin' huh?
That couple there's gettin' on my nerves. Why do they hafta come be lovey-dovey 'round me!?
Come on, let's do it right now.
People can hear you! And see us!
Oh, don't be a buzzkill! Let's pretend we're doin' a shady deal.
He told me to go west, so I turned left on the street, but I can't find it. Where is this Ose Bridge?
Nice bod ya got there, hehehe...
Whew. This bridge is a good place to jog!
I can't believe there are people who litter without a care in the world! Were they raised by animals?
Yeah, I highly doubt they'd be driving a flower parade car around this time of year.
I'm telling you, I saw one! There was even a blinky red light on the roof.

I'm pretty sure what you saw was a taxi. That's the only
explanation I can think of.
(A taxi with a blinking red light? Hmm...)
Wah!
Oh shoot! Uh, can we help you, sir?
I don't mean to interrupt, but can you tell me about this taxi you saw?
Well, she says she saw a taxi with a blinking red light. Right?
Yeah. What do you call those lights taxis have on the roof? Uhh... Anyway, the taxi I saw had one of those.
I told her I've never seen anything like that before.
I saw it, I swear! Maybe it only happens to people who are lucky. Ooh, maybe we should go buy a lottery ticket!
You two get to learn something today.
The light you see on a taxi's roof⑬that usually means it's not carrying a passenger, correct?
Oh, uh, right.
But in an emergency, you can make it blink red to warn those around you that something's wrong.
Like what...?
For example, if the driver is attacked by a thief, they can press a button to silently call for help.
Seriously!? So that taxi I saw...
Where did you see it?
It was stopped on Nagasu Boulevard. North of the intersection up ahead. That was a little while ago now, though, so it might already be gone.
(It's probably too late to call the police now. I'll go and check it out myself.)
I'll go and take a look. Can you notify the police, just in case?
Are you sure you're gonna be all right, dude?
Drivers always come to help anyone showing that signal, even when it's another company.
Oh, so you're a taxi driver, too?

Dang, I straight-up thought you were yakuz⑬ I mean, that
explains why you know so much! Be careful, then.
Brr... Huh? Can I help you?
Ya got the treasure from the map?
Congratulations! That's right!
You did a great job finding me. Here's your prize.
You got Spicy Knife.
Finally, I can go find somewhere warm... I was this close to freezing to death.
Do de do de doo... Huh? What is it?
You got Brickshitter Beer.
Okay, time to head home.
Sheesh, my toes are numb... Huh? What's up?
You got Purgatory Rod.
Glad that's over with. I'm so frickin' cold.
Heh. You'll have to give me the right code. What's the first number?
Okay, what's the second number?
Nope, wrong.
That's correct! The answer was indeed 14. Here's your prize.
You got Hungry Wolf Gloves.
I'm so cold... But my little Polin-chan is too cute! Huh? What is it?
That's correct! You found me! Here's your prize.
You got Skyrocket.
Well, I'll be going, then.
Hmmm. What would make a good souvenir for my coworkers?
Well, Fukuoka is pretty famous for mentaiko, right? You know, spicy cod roe?
Oh yeah! Wonder where we can pick some up.
I think I saw some over at that place Fukuya on Nagasu Boulevard. Want to pop over there?
Hold on, maybe we shouldn't get any souvenirs after all. I told everyone I was home with the flu, remember?
Oh, right. Sometimes it's hard to keep track of all your excuses...
(<Color:255,200,200,255>Mentaiko from Fukuya<Color:Default>, huh? That might make a good gift for Tenjin Transportation.)
I need something good to give to that client of ours. Their president's all pissed off about something or other and I've gotta make up for it or my head's on the chopping block.
Hm... Well, everyone loves something fancy, right?
You know that place Le Marche? I bet he'd cheer up right away if you presented him with a box with their logo on it.
Ugh, it's almost like he acts like he's mad just so people'll give him stuff to apologize. Pretty scummy if you ask me.
(<Color:255,200,200,255>Brand goods from Le Marche<Color:Default>, huh? That might make a good gift for Tenjin Transportation, but I bet it would cost an arm and a leg.)
So, uh... are you ready to go see your parents?
The real question is if <Italic>you're</Italic> ready. Did you remember to bring a gift?
Huh? Oh crap, it totally slipped my mind! Now what?
Don't worry, honeybear. Maybe you could just pick up a bottle of something from the convenience store?
Convenience store booze? In what world does that seem appropriate for my first time meeting your parents!?
It'll be fine! They haven't minded it with any of my other boyfriends.
Wait... what? I thought we were exclusive!
(<Color:255,200,200,255>Something from the convenience store<Color:Default>, huh? That would definitely be easy, but I'm not sure how good a gift it would make.)
Man, Maki-chan's birthday's coming up soon, but I don't got the cash for a present.
That's 'cause you're always looking at the newest stuff! Your wallet'll thank you if you start buying from the pawn shop instead.
You want me to give my sweet Maki-chan a gift someone else has already had their grubby hands on!?
She'll never know the difference! It's always worked for me.
No kidding. Well, as long as she doesn't find out...
(<Color:255,200,200,255>A pawn shop<Color:Default>, huh? Might be a good place to buy something nice at a discount. I might even find something to use as a gift for Tenjin Transportation.)
Hey, buddy. You better stay away from those guys in the red tracksuits.
They're yakuza. The Yamagasa Family runs Nagasu, and their captain's crew wears those weird tracksuits. Hell, they look like they're goin' to gym class, heh.
It makes it easy to know who's who, at least. Let sleeping dogs lie, and all that.
You see those guys out in the street earlier? One side in red tracksuits, the other in black suit suits?
The red tracksuit dudes are Yahata Family yakuza. They work for this guy Yahata, one of the Yamagasa Family captains.
Bet my left pinky the guys in black suits were yakuza, too. Guys were fierce.
I was gettin' a good booze on, too, but that sure sobered me up. Guess I'll just go home...
Boy, I'm glad the rent here is so cheap.
Yeah? Isn't it like that everywhere?
Don't be silly. You'd never get anything under 10,000 yen a month in Tokyo, except in a dorm. My parents don't send me much to get by on, so I'm glad I can afford to live here.
I never knew.
Thanks for those energy drinks you brought us the other day! You really helped drag us out of the mid-week slump!
What, those old things? It was nothing. Just picked 'em up on a whim over at the drugstore.
It was so much more than nothing! I'd even say it was <Italic>something</Italic>! Gee, it's great to work for a company that looks after its workers!
You say that now, but just wait. Give it a few more years, and you'll start resenting people for thinking a little drink somehow makes up for the constant crunch.
Me, resenting our work? Not a chance!
(<Color:255,200,200,255>An energy drink from the drugstore<Color:Default>, huh? The drivers at Tenjin Transportation might appreciate a gift like that.)
I hear it's dangerous on the highway these days.
Huh? Why's that?
Street racers are picking fights with folks in luxury cars and sports cars and completely trashing them.
Huh. Just idiots with time on their hands, I guess. You don't need to worry, though, huh? What with that old clunker you drive.
Yeah, I guess you're right.
Wish we could do something about those Devil Killers...
Right now we've got our hands full with the Yamagasa Family and Tojo Clan. We can't spare anyone to deal with those street racers.
Sure, but look at all the trouble they're causing.
I know, but there's nothing we can do. Just pray the Tojo Clan leaves town soon.
I'm so worried about my boyfriend... Apparently, he just joined a street racing team called the Devil Killers.
Wait, how old is he again? He's in his mid-twenties, right? Doesn't he have anything better to do with his time like, I don't know, find a real job?
I know, but he says it's always been his dream to be a street racer! Though I've heard so many rumors about their crazy driving...
Why are you still with that bozo, again?
I'm tired. Let's get a taxi.
Sure. We should be able to catch one here.
Oh, but no taxis from Tenjin Transportation. I hear their drivers are terrible.
Yeah? What should I look for, then?
Nagasu Taxi is the best bet around here. They know all the roads, and always drive safely.
If you say so. I really don't care which one we get in.
You seen those mean-looking guy in black suits? They've been patrolling this area since like, yesterday.
Yeah. They've got to in the business, you know? They're frickin' everywhere, man.
I hear they've got some beef with those guys in the red tracksuits. Scary stuff. Let's go before we get caught up in the middle of something.
I bet those two guys in the black suits are yakuza.
Yeah. Things have been getting pretty chaotic around here lately. Maybe we should get out of here...
Are you kidding? Did you see those scary looks on their faces? There's gotta be something big going on. Bet we'll get to see a bunch of action!
Please, can we not? Let's just head home.
Y'know, if I didn't know better I'd say those guys were yakuza.
Sorry, ma'am. Did you just say yakuza?
Huh? Oh, yes. There were some guys lookin' all flashy in these bright red tracksuits. Kinda seemed like a gang uniform.
